caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair painted in a muted green color, positioned at a slight angle so that both the seat and the backrest are visible. The chair has a simple, rustic design with two horizontal slats forming the backrest, supported by four vertical spindles that connect the seat to the top slat. The seat is flat and slightly curved, showing areas where the green paint has worn away, exposing the brown wood underneath, particularly on the front edge, top corner of the backrest, and near the left side of the seat. The chair's four legs taper towards the bottom and are reinforced with two horizontal stretchers connecting the front legs to the back legs. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present. The artist's signature, "Frank T. Fiselman," is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Chair
